title: One List for the Week
pin_title: ADHD Thanksgiving Prep: One Short List Instead of Twenty Open Tabs
description: Holiday weeks multiply open loops fast. Instead of keeping every errand in your head, write one short list of only the next three things. When one is done, add the next. A single visible list reduces the feeling that everything is urgent at once. Progress still counts when the list is short. #ADHD #Thanksgiving #ADHDTips #HolidayPrep

title: Too Many Choices in Aisle
pin_title: ADHD Grocery Overwhelm: Shrink the List Before You Enter the Store
description: Supermarket aisles are decision factories. Before you go, write only the items you truly need for the next two days. If the list is longer than one side of a card, cut it. A shorter list makes the trip feel possible and reduces impulse grabs. You can always return tomorrow. #ADHD #ADHDLife #Grocery #DecisionMaking A small visible step is still progress for an ADHD brain.
